_comment: /me 页面的编辑性文案。所有会变的内容都放这里，代码里不留硬编码字符串。
纯数据（姓名、邮箱、作品、曲目）不重复写在这里 —— meData.js 会去 profile.json /
projects.json / music.json 里取，避免同一个事实存两份、改一处漏一处。
items[].projectId 对应 projects.json 的 id；改作品只改这个 id。

badge.en: Currently building AI skills and writing music

heroTagline.zh: 在代码、像素和声音之间游走。做一些安静的、需要耐心的东西。
heroTagline.en: Drifting between code, pixels and sound — quiet things that take patience.

desc.zh: 它们不是三个标签，而是同一种好奇心的三种表达方式。
desc.en: Not three labels — three expressions of the same curiosity.

desc.zh: 15+ 年互联网研发，其中 7 年带队。做过地铁系统国产化替代、歪马送酒小程序、京东羚珑智能设计平台。喜欢把复杂的事拆简单，再交给合适的人。
desc.en: 15+ years in engineering, 7 of them leading teams — metro system localisation, the Waima liquor mini-program, JD's Linglong design platform. I like making complex things simple, then handing them to the right people.

desc.zh: 把重复劳动写成技能：视频剪辑、热点选题、文案、UI 验收、图标生成……开源的 iskill- 系列已经能跑完整条内容流水线。这个站点本身也是它们的产物。
desc.en: Turning repetitive work into skills — video clipping, topic scouting, copywriting, UI verification, icon generation. The open-source iskill- series already runs a full content pipeline, and this very site is one of its outputs.

desc.zh: 用模拟合成器和采样做 lo-fi 与氛围音乐，在网易云发了 6 首。这个页面的背景音也是现场合成的 —— 没有一个音频文件。
desc.en: Lo-fi and ambient music made with analog synths and samples — six tracks on Netease. Even the sound on this page is synthesised live; there is not a single audio file.

desc.zh: 一些做完了、一些还在做、一些永远不会做完。
desc.en: Some finished, some still going, some that will never be done.
